Initial release of AI-powered pet social interaction analysis for multi-pet households.

- Detects and classifies cat-cat, dog-dog, and cat-dog interactions (sniffing, chasing, biting, fleeing, hiding, playing) from fixed camera videos.
- Records duration, frequency, initiator, and receiver for each interaction and generates a structured social-behavior report.
- Includes strict open-id (user identity) acquisition and validation for report management and history queries.
- Supports automatic historical report queries with results output as Markdown tables with clickable report links.
- Designed for multi-pet families, boarding centers, daycare, and animal behavior clinics; provides only behavior observation with no training or medical advice.
